name: Swan Hill River Walk

facts.claim: 4.5 km walking trail along the Murray starting at the Pump Station, Milloo Street, passing many of the town's attractions
Easy walk ending north of Pental Island Bridge, around two hours

name: Lake Boga Flying Boat Museum

facts.claim: Museum on the shores of Lake Boga, between Swan Hill and Kerang, telling the story of the secret No. 1 Flying Boat Repair Depot (1942-1947)
Heritage-listed Catalina flying boat and original underground communications bunker are at the heart of the museum
About 500 artefacts on display plus interactive displays and personal stories

name: Shepparton Art Museum

facts.claim: Art museum at 530 Wyndham St, Shepparton; the current $50 million building opened in November 2021
Holds over 4,000 artworks, including one of Australia's largest ceramic collections and works by the Namatjira family
Entry is free, though certain exhibitions may be ticketed
